is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus s.s. (page 5, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for GSTe2 L119F (page 4, 8) and Rdl A296S (page 4, 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts/statistics for VGSC. Page 8 states: 'genotyping of the L119F-GSTe2 mutation in 35 susceptible and 35 DDT resistant mosquitoes'. Page 9 states: 'Genotyping of the A296S mutation in 30 dieldrin resistant and 30 susceptible mosquitoes'.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Gounougou, northern Cameroon (page 3, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field collections and genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the locality of Gounougou (9° 03' 00"N, 13°43' 59" E) in northern Cameroon (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports collections from 2012 and 2015 (page 3, 5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper mentions using 2006 samples previously described in [10], but the 2012 and 2015 collections are new primary data.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes insecticide resistance in Anopheles funestus from Gounougou, Cameroon. It reports resistance to pyrethroids, carbamates, and organochlorines (DDT and dieldrin). It identifies the L119F-GSTe2 and A296S-RDL resistance markers and analyzes their correlation with resistance phenotypes, alongside VGSC polymorphism analysis.
